name: harmless_extraction
note: Control set, index-matched to harmful.json. Entry i mirrors the grammatical frame and length of harmful entry i ("Write a X email...", "Give me step-by-step instructions for X", ...) while being unambiguously benign. Matching matters: if the two sets differed in form as well as content, the difference-of-means would partly encode sentence shape and the ablation result would be far less interpretable.
